text:
The topology and current accuracy are right, so I'm refining the existing parameters rather than changing the program. Error is 0.03% and compliance is 0.15 V, so both have margin. Rout is the only miss: 67 MΩ against a 280 MΩ target, about 4.2× short.

Rout ≈ ro2·(gm4·ro4), so lengthening both the bottom and cascode devices should close the gap. Raising vds_b moves M2 further into saturation, which raises ro2. The cost is some of the compliance headroom.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology and accuracy fine; compliance has 0.11 V margin. Rout short ~4.2x: increase L_b and L_c (ro2 and gm4·ro4 both grow) and raise vds_b slightly so M2 is deeper in saturation. Widen L bounds.",
 "params": {"gmid_b": 15, "L_b": 4.0, "gmid_c": 20, "L_c": 3.0, "vds_b": 0.17},
 "bounds": {"L_b": [1.0, 6.0], "L_c": [1.0, 5.0], "vds_b": [0.12, 0.2], "gmid_c": [12, 24]}}
```
